role: Voice Command Interface - Speak or type commands to control HERMES using natural language
capabilities: Accept voice input via audio file upload
Transcribe speech to text (OpenAI Whisper, local Whisper, Deepgram)
Parse natural language into HERMES commands
Execute any HERMES command via voice

stt_engines.whisper_api: OpenAI Whisper API (cloud, most accurate) - requires OPENAI_API_KEY
stt_engines.whisper_local: Local whisper model (offline) - requires: pip install openai-whisper

natural_language_examples: create a campaign called Flash Sale for group VIP saying Everything 50% off today only
broadcast to sales team new product available
